decisions.reason: Because the sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established postpress know-how and remained on its own website page in 2024, management would expect it can learn and improve it despite no clear evidence of strong in-house R&D.

Because the folding add-on unit is close to the firm's core finishing portfolio and was still mentioned in 2024 with a concrete customer-use result, management would see enough related knowledge and market validation to keep it on the market.
